items.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the people who were writing for the band, John Lewis

ctx.x: Andy [Duryea]...I can’t think of Andy’s last name on trombone. It was a dynamic band, and, of course, the people who were writing for the band, John Lewis....um and other prominent writers.
So, were some of the–you mentioned Sabu Martinez–were a lot of the Afro- Cuban pieces still being played by the orchestra at this time?
